claim: The demo uses separate sample data, resets safely, and expires after 24 hours.
where: landing facts, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: clean real and demo contexts; preserve a real invoice while demo resets, expire a demo through the debug-only fixture, recover with Reset demo, and prove its old status read/write URLs return 404

claim: Saved client AP profiles can be reused without changing earlier invoice packets.
sandbox: demo workspace; create invoices with two profiles, edit one profile, and assert the first invoice packet, email recipient, and status sender retain its saved profile

claim: The preflight flags required invoice details before sending.
sandbox: demo workspace; create a valid invoice, create one missing a selected profile's PO, switch a ready invoice to that profile, and assert both send attempts return 400

claim: Exports the selected invoice receipt trail as CSV.
sandbox: demo workspace with two invoices; download the selected invoice CSV and assert its header, escaped receipt text, and exclusion of the other invoice event

claim: Builds a printable invoice packet and prepared email for the selected invoice.
sandbox: demo workspace with two invoices; select each in turn, send/copy/open the packet, assert the status token and invoice details match selection, and invoke print

claim: A finance recipient can update a status link and create a receipt event.
sandbox: demo invoice; mark it sent, submit received with a note on its status page, and assert the matching invoice status and event

claim: Bank and tax fields are encrypted before storage.
sandbox: demo invoice; copy the isolated test SQLite database and assert its selected row contains neither bank nor tax plaintext

claim: The product loads no analytics or tracking requests.
sandbox: fresh demo browser context; record all requests across demo, packet, send, and status flows and assert only the product origin occurs

claim: No checkout or paid gate is shown while external registration is pending.
sandbox: landing, demo, and pricing routes; assert there is no checkout URL, paid price, or disabled status action
